question: Where can I find a hospital that fall inside a 110 kilometers boundary to the northeast of Sloth Encounters, Hauppauge, NY?
sql: SELECT id, poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'hospital' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sloth Encounters%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 110000 ) AND degrees( ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sloth Encounters%' LIMIT 1 ), p.geometry ) ) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5;
